JPG to PNG Converter

Convert JPG photos to PNG format instantly in your browser. Handles multiple files at once with individual downloads or a single ZIP archive.

🖼️ Drop JPG files here or click to browse
    FileOriginalPNG size

    PNG files are lossless, so they are usually larger than the original JPG. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

    📖 How to use

    1. Drop one or more JPG/JPEG files into the upload zone.
    2. Click “Convert to PNG” — each image is re-encoded as a lossless PNG.
    3. Check the per-file size table (PNGs are usually larger than JPGs).
    4. Download each PNG individually or all together as a ZIP.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    Why convert JPG to PNG?

    PNG is lossless and supports transparency, which makes it better for graphics, logos and screenshots. JPG is smaller and better for photos.

    Will I lose quality?

    Yes — JPG does not support transparency, so there is nothing to recover. The PNG keeps every pixel of the JPG exactly as it was.

    Are my photos uploaded?

    No. Conversion happens on a canvas in your browser. Your photos are never uploaded to any server.
